target.description: Decode circular position relative to reward from CA1 activity, retaining Fig. 3 before-switch and after-switch conditions and RR, TR and non-RR cell panels; Fig. 2 remapping outputs remain calibration.

dataset.description: Author preprocessed Figshare 27098065 and postprocessed 27138633 are identified, but exact immutable files and Fig. 3 sample mapping remain unadmitted. The registered DANDI version differs from the current author download route.

cohort.description: Fig. 3 includes 11 switching mice over seven switch days, 77 sessions; smaller animal/session subsets cannot substitute.

split.description: Paper specifies tenfold 90/10 fitting before the switch, testing before or after, and last 30 post-switch trials for matched support. Exact realized folds and occupancy sample indices remain absent; chronological half-session calibration is an extension.

inputs.description: Deconvolved calcium event time series for each original cell subpopulation. Historical retrospective RR classification must be reproduced and disclosed; any train-only classification changes need a separately labelled comparison.

preprocessing.description: Source speed threshold is >2 cm/s and occupancy matching uses 45 circular bins. Exact position/reward alignment, teleport treatment, stochastic classifications and downsampling realization still need binding.

metric.description: Per-sample score cos(theta_RR - theta_hat_RR), higher is better; Fig. 3b compares session means with shuffle means. Effect size 2.7 for post-switch RR is not a cosine score.

aggregation.description: Fig. 3b averages time samples and cross-validation folds within session; Fig. 3c uses session-shuffle z-scores and animal averages. These remain distinct endpoints.

full_panel.description: Original registered reproduction is complete Figures 2 and 3 for all 11 switching mice and seven switch days (77 sessions), with original exclusions and source companions. Fig. 3 native support is 77 sessions x 3 cell populations (rr, track, nonreward_remap) x 5 models (train0_test0, train0_test1, train1_test1, train1_test0, random) = 1155 conditions. The 462 train0_test0/train0_test1 conditions form Fig. 3b; the other 693 remain required companions. Retain all ten ordered test folds, real sample predictions/targets, training selections and 100 shuffle realizations, without collapsing conditions. Mandatory Fig. 3c retains real/shuffle binwise scores and z-scores for both cross-switch directions, every day and population, and first/last-switch source profiles with animal means and SEM. The inspected source has 45 linspace edges and 44 intervals; do not silently reinterpret the inherited 45-bin wording. Fig. 3a requires its non-downsampled example trace rather than the downsampled quantification illustration. Fig. 2 requires original remapping masks and class census, cell-level circular peaks/cross-correlations, actual/shuffle histograms, individual and pooled above-shuffle fractions, switch trends, and reward-exclusion and preceding/following curves. The scalar findings below represent actual source summaries only. Required arrays remain unrepresented by the scalar schema; no complete-panel admission is claimed. The exact inherited target wording about Fig. 2 calibration is preserved for improvement-contract identity, not used to remove Fig. 2 from this first-class reproduction outcome.

permitted_observations.description: Reproduction requires authentic source fluorescence/deconvolved events, behavior and reward coordinates needed to reconstruct Figures 2/3, with all original source retrospective cell classification and occupancy-matching privileges disclosed. Postprocessed identities are reference/reconstruction evidence and cannot substitute for proof of recalculation. An improvement prediction boundary must separately resolve source-matched training labels, owner-held evaluation targets and retrospective classifications; the chronological neural-only extension is not the original split. Paper+data and paper+data+author-code must share original cohort, samples, folds, observations, preprocessing, metric/aggregation, evaluator and cumulative budgets, with author code the only added information. Authentic immutable exposure and input manifests are absent.

blocking_issues: The scalar schema cannot represent the required Fig. 3b full session table, Fig. 3c position profiles, Fig. 2 cell masks/histograms and exclusion-distance curves, or original example traces. They remain mandatory in full_panel and the external granular-interface inventory. A reviewed structured-output extension or source-faithful complete evaluator is needed before admission; the scalar subset is not the full reproduction contract.

Some Fig. 2 scalar targets were verified in the primary article, but no complete expected numerical table, figure source array or Fig. 3 statistical vector is bound. The preserved improvement contract mentions post-switch RR effect size 2.7, but the later article read was blocked and this sidecar does not relabel that inherited statement as a newly source-verified complete target. Printed values alone would not be executed reproduction.

The pinned current author revision is inspected source, not proof of the historical publication revision. A source-supported protocol-equivalent stochastic rerun with recorded new random state is admissible in principle; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. Such a rerun and its calibration have not occurred.

Authentic ordered cohort/cell/sample manifests, original occupancy selections and training/test fold receipts are missing. Native pickle authentication, safe loader custody and complete original preprocessed/postprocessed provenance remain unresolved.

Fig. 3b score construction consumes predictions and support but does not fit the author decoder, verify original retrospective memberships/occupancy sampling, or establish authentic data use. It does not implement Fig. 3c or Fig. 2. Its 1e-10 stored-score consistency check is software arithmetic only, not a reproduction tolerance.

Source Fig. 3 has 45 linspace edges (44 intervals); the unchanged improvement anchor says 45 bins. Source-specific alignment, teleport treatment, endpoint handling and bin identities must be resolved explicitly rather than silently altered.

Full Fig. 2 exclusions, cell-class overlap handling, shuffle realizations, logit missingness and source statistical decisions need independent output verification. The scoped 77-session cohort cannot be reduced to fit compute. Extended Data-only stay-day analyses are not silently added to this original switch-day task.

No source-justified tolerance, stochastic agreement rule or uncertainty criterion is frozen. Source session-level significance, effect size, mean/SEM and shuffle percentiles are distinct outputs and cannot substitute for computational equivalence.

No authentic-data analysis interface covering all findings, independent verification program, immutable full-panel/observation identities, protected paired delivery or matched cumulative access/resource budgets is admitted. Therefore admission_policy is omitted and both pairing protocols remain null.
